name: trek-iq
description: Accessibility-focused routing and data visualization web app for Halifax

scripts.copy:build:
node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('public'))fs.mkdirSync('public',{recursive:true});if(fs.existsSync('client/build')){fs.cpSync('client/build','public',{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('Client build files copied successfully');}else if(fs.existsSync('public/index.html')){console.log('Using existing public files');}else{console.log('Warning: No build files found, creating minimal index.html');fs.writeFileSync('public/index.html','Trek.iQ

Trek.iQ Loading...

');}"
scripts.build:full: cd client && npm install && node node_modules/react-scripts/bin/react-scripts.js build && cd .. && npm run copy:build
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install

author: Trek.IQ Team
